english.title: Fail co-operate with office - holder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with an obligation imposed on you by section 235 of the Insolvency Act 1986 in that you did not

(A)_[give the office-holder, namely **(..SPECIFY..), such information concerning the company]_
(B)_[attend on the office-holder, namely **(..SPECIFY..), at such time]_

as was reasonably required
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 235(5) of and Schedule 10 to the Insolvency Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed without reasonable excuse to comply with obligation imposed by s. 235
did not give office-holder information regarding the company/attend on office-holder at such time
as reasonably required

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See sections 234(1) and 235(1) for application and section 235(3) for persons on whom the obligations are imposed.
(ii) See sections 234(1) and 235(1) for meaning of 'office- holder'.

other.penalty:
INDICTMENT: A fine - and a daily default fine of one tenth of the statutory maximum where contravention is continued.
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
